name: nucleus
description: Nucleus — one operating system of portable AI workflows and shared memory for Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex.

plugins.name: cortex
plugins.description: Cortex. Recall, search, and explicitly commit to one user-owned Cortex memory store from Claude, ChatGPT, or Codex.

plugins.name: alignment
plugins.description: Team Alignment. Scan configured Slack sources for cross-team alignment signals and produce daily pulses, weekly reports, and risk updates.

plugins.name: ops
plugins.description: Chief of Staff. Use a natural-language chief-of-staff front door, analyze CRM pipeline, inspect Nucleus health, record agent metrics, and register schedules when the host supports them.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research. Find recent stories, rank them for a configured audience, and assemble a voice-matched roundup with traceable sources.

plugins.name: clients
plugins.description: Client Success. Create an engagement plan, portable AI workspace prompt, folder blueprint, and next action; draft weekly client-status updates; and run structured deliverable QA.

plugins.name: admin
plugins.description: Admin. Turn calendar events into a local, reviewable time log and generate invoice drafts from configured client billing rules.

plugins.name: growth
plugins.description: Growth Engine. Build a daily relationship cockpit, research contacts, act on buying signals and referral opportunities, rebalance a network, and create context-aware touchpoint drafts.

plugins.name: comms
plugins.description: Comms Desk. Create voice-matched drafts, compare drafts with final edits, and propose durable style-rule updates only after repeated evidence.

plugins.name: briefing
plugins.description: Today's Brief. Combine calendar, tasks, outreach, inbox, CRM, and Cortex context into a daily brief, then process user-approved annotations and plan tomorrow.
